page.title: Audio
page.description: Text-to-speech settings, the runtime queue, and the OBS Browser Source audio output - built on the same normalized Engagement Event Bus as Alerts and Chat.

fields.enabledHint: When off, no event is ever spoken and the Browser Source stays silent.
fields.supporterOnlyModeHint: When on, only supporter-family events (bits, subscriptions, gifted subs, memberships, Super Chat/Sticker, donations) are eligible, regardless of the event types selected below.
fields.eventTypesHint: Empty means none - text-to-speech is opt-in per event type, never everything by default.
fields.providersHint: Leave empty to match every provider.
fields.sourcesHint: Leave empty to match every connected account and donation source.
fields.thresholdHint: An event in a different currency is never compared against this threshold.
fields.perUserCooldownHint: 0-3600. Applies only to events with a stable identity - never an anonymous donation.
fields.globalCooldownHint: 0-300. Applies to every eligible event regardless of who triggered it.
fields.normalizeRepeatedCharsHint: "sooooo" becomes "sooo" - never a multi-second elongated pronunciation.
fields.suppressCommandsHint: Only applies to chat messages - a donation message starting with "!" is still spoken.
fields.manualApprovalHint: A real eligible event waits for Approve/Reject instead of speaking immediately.

browserSource.title: Browser Source
browserSource.rotateConfirmMessage: The current URL will stop working immediately. Update the Browser Source in OBS with the new URL afterward.
browserSource.hint: Add this URL once as a Browser Source in OBS. It renders no visible content of its own - only audio.

status.title: Status
status.waitingForRenderer: Waiting for the Browser Source to connect.
status.inputGapWarning: The Event Bus connection was briefly lost and later reconnected - some events during that window may not have been matched.

queue.title: Queue
queue.clearConfirmMessage: Every queued (not yet playing) item is removed. The item currently playing, if any, is not affected.

testSpeak.title: Test Speak
testSpeak.placeholder: Type text to test the pipeline...
testSpeak.hint: Goes through the real preprocessing pipeline and the real queue, but never touches real cooldowns and never contacts Twitch, YouTube, or StreamElements.
